question: What does the most recent news article on proteinatlas.org report: which journal was the study published in, who led the team, and what did they identify?

turns.text: The most recent news article on **proteinatlas.org** is the “From spatial proteomics to tissue validation: DHCR7 in early ovarian cancer” (published 2026‑08‑13). The article explains that the authors’ study was published in **Nature Metabolism**; the research team was led by **J. Green** (first author and group leader); and the work identified **DHCR7 as a new protein marker that is up‑regulated in early ovarian cancer**【https://www.proteinatlas.org/news/2026-08-13/from-spatial-proteomics-to-tissue-validation-dhcr7-in-early-ovarian-cancer】.
